titulo: Putting together the first year retrospective
resumo: A recipe for turning the year's collection into a video or an album the whole family will want to see.

secoes.titulo: The simplest running order that works
itens: One photo from each month, from the same spot if you have it.
Three short videos: one from the beginning, one from the middle, one recent.
Your voice over the top, saying what happened in that month.
End with the photo from the day she was born and today's photo, side by side.

secoes.texto: Everyone gets stuck trying to choose between three hundred photos. Do not choose the best ones: choose one per month, in order, and carry on. A retrospective that got made is worth infinitely more than a perfect one that did not.
